title: Unit Event — What Lies Beyond Guiding a Lost Child — Episode3 SEKAI's Newest Arrival

meta.Event: What Lies Beyond Guiding a Lost Child
meta.Event Outline: With university practice exams looming, Mafuyu continues to study to meet her mother's expectations. Meanwhile, Mizuki suggests a trip to an amusement park for N25.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (My head... I'm having trouble focusing... But I need to find the others...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(Hm? What's going on...?
They're acting a little different than usual...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
It's okay.
Don't be scared... Let's be friends!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You know that's just gonna scare him more, right?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Well, you may just want to see for yourself.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
So...
Do you think you can say hello?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hmm... He really doesn't want to come out from behind Miku...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Maybe he's shy... Or just embarrassed...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: A mix of both from what I can tell.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, exactly!
I came over to SEKAI to take a break from what I was doing and saw Len here!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I felt like I had to tell all of you immediately, so I sent out messages in a hurry.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I mean, you could've just told us that instead of saying, “There's something I need to tell everyone.”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But it's nice to see more faces in SEKAI!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I agree...
But Len still doesn't seem very comfortable here...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I spoke with him a little before you all came here, but he's still a bit nervous it seems...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And yet, he's sticking close to you, Miku...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Probably because Miku's the one who found him and brought him over to where we were...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Don't be afraid to open up to us a little more, okay?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh? He seems quite afraid of you too, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Now you're just putting words in his mouth...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Haha...
Let's get to know Len by taking it slow.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Just don't regret your decision, okay...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
What's wrong...?
You look like you're in pain.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You know we're all worried because your face says otherwise, right?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Why don't you just tell us in your own words?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I have to keep studying for it, but...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Slow down. Don't jump ahead like that. Why is it a bad thing that Mafuyu's mom found her synthesizer...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, it's not that it's a bad thing, but it could get kinda ugly...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Hang on...
Have you not told her about us making music?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
No...
Because I think all she wants me to do is study.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: She even tried to get rid of the synthesizer in my room once already...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You're kidding, right? Who goes that far to make their kid study?!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Luckily, I was able to save it from the junk removers that time...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But you said your mom found it back in your room. Does that mean...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: She said she's going to hold onto it, which probably means she's going to toss it at some point...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: That's horrible. She's taking your stuff away even though you haven't done anything wrong...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Um, Mafuyu, mind telling us a little more about your mom...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I doubt you'll find it all that interesting...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, there's that.
And I get that talking to someone else about your own family isn't easy.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, you don't have to tell us if you don't want to.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: All I'm saying is that if it'll take a load off your mind, we'd be more than happy to hear what you have to say.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hear what I have to say...?
